Title: CLX Innovation Center SharePoint Site
Description:
The official one-stop-shop for information about all innovation efforts happening within the Customer Learning Experience (CLX) group.

One of the solutions that came out of our CLX Innovation Hackathon event, the CLX Innovation Center SharePoint site aims to "provide full transparency on everything we're doing with AI and automation."

Title: Release Notes GenAI Tool
Description:
This tool aims to reduce the editorial hours spent on RN descriptions by 100%.

By using the Azure OpenAI Service available within Deltek’s Azure DevOps (ADO) platform, this plug-in tool enables anyone from each product engineering group who has access to ADO projects to use generative AI technology to edit RN descriptions directly from their projects' work items.

To access the tool:
1. From Deltek's ADO/TFS instance, open a project's work item (such as Feature, PBI, or Bug).
2. Click More actions (...).
3. Select Generate Edited Description.

Title: User Story and Acceptance Criteria GenAI Tool
Description:
This tool is designed to streamline the creation of clear, concise, and consistent Agile documentation across product engineering teams.

By leveraging the Azure OpenAI Service integrated within Deltek’s Azure DevOps (ADO) platform, this plug-in tool enables any team member with access to ADO projects to generate or enhance user stories and acceptance criteria directly within their work items.

This tool aligns with Agile@Deltek principles by helping reduce manual effort and promoting clarity, consistency, and efficiency across the software development lifecycle. It is designed to benefit not only writers, but also product managers, developers, QA engineers, and other stakeholders involved in product delivery.

To access the tool:
1. From Deltek's ADO/TFS instance, open a project's work item (such as Feature or PBI).
2. Click More actions (...).
3. Select Generate Acceptance Criteria.

Title: Costpoint Summary Excel Listing Generator
Description:
This tool aims to streamline the creation of a Maintenance Release Summary Excel reports from TFS query data. 

To generate Excel reports:
1. Download the generator .exe file.
2. Export a Costpoint maintenance release query from TFS in CSV format and save it locally.
3. Run the executable:
    a. Double-click the executable to open it.
    b. When prompted, enter the version number and click Generate Excel.
    c. Select the CSV file containing the MR query data.

Description: This tool aims to automate the generation of release notes and works hand-in-hand with the Release Notes GenAI tool.

Description:
Recommends updates to OLH/Admin Guide sections to reflect updated process behavior based on transcript excerpts. Title: TFS Release Notes Generator
Description: The TFS Release Notes Generator is a web-based tool for creating release notes. It pulls work items directly from TFS, lets you review and filter them based on your team’s needs, and exports the results in Markdown or PDF format. The content comes from the Documentation tab of each work item, which is populated using the Generate Edited Description TFS plugin.

Title: Release Content Assistant
Description: Release Content Assistant is an AI assistant used with Copilot to help keep release information aligned across formats. It supports Release Highlights, What’s New videos, and What’s New IAGs by adapting the same source to different levels of detail, while following Deltek voice and tone. It’s assistive only and does not invent content.

Title: Markdown Validator
Description: This validator checks all Markdown files within a bundle for formatting, structure, and link issues. It helps quickly identify issues across multiple files in a single run, eliminating the need to review each file individually.

Title: TS to article converter Agent
Description:
This agent transforms raw video transcripts into structured, AI-optimized Markdown guides by removing conversational filler, organizing topics logically, and converting buried procedures into numbered steps. It reduces token overhead for AI queries by enabling precise section retrieval instead of full-document scanning, eliminating the need for a live Learning Hub connection each time. The output serves as a reusable, KM-ready knowledge artifact that improves both human discoverability and AI retrieval quality across support workflows.
The processed guide will be included in the videos replacing the transcripts and topics covered sections. This will be implemented moving forward and included in the MD conversion effort.

Title: Markdown MegaBundle Processing Tool
Description:
A single PowerShell script that automates all documentation fileset processing in one run. Point it at a bundle folder and it handles everything:

Step A — Prefixes image files (media\ or images\) and updates all .md references
Step B — Prefixes all content .md files and rewrites every internal link to match
Registry — Tracks prefixes in .prefix-registry.tsv to prevent collisions across bundles
Step C — Merges the bundle TOC into the master Costpoint_Advanced\index.md (optional)
Multi-folder — Process a single folder, several named folders, or every subfolder inside a parent directory in one call
